# NETCONF fixtures

Sanitized / synthetic XML shaped like the HiOS 10.7.00 BETA83 BRS
YumaWorks NETCONF replies (IETF `ietf-interfaces` and `ietf-system`
only). Values are placeholders — no lab addresses, hostnames, MACs,
serials, contact/location strings, or credentials.

Used by `tests/unit/test_netconf_hios.py`.
